info.description:
Учёт корпоративных подписок на ПО: реестр подписок и лицензий, заявки с согласованием (сотрудник → начальник отдела → админ), платежи, уведомления, аудит, аналитика и рекомендации по экономии.
Успешный ответ — сам объект (списки — `items` и `total`/`limit`/`offset`), без обёртки; ошибка — JSON с полем `description`. Суть результата передаёт HTTP-статус.
Вход: `POST /auth/login`, затем кнопка Authorize и значение `Bearer <token>`.
info.title: SubTrack API

get.description: Active subscriptions grouped by category (case-insensitively), most expensive first, with their share. A head gets their own department.
get.summary: Monthly cost by category (admin, department head)

get.description: Every department with its active subscriptions' monthly cost, seats, active users and cost per user, most expensive first; department_id null holds the company-wide subscriptions.
Active subscriptions grouped by vendor (case-insensitively), most expensive first, with their share. A head gets their own department.
get.summary: Monthly cost by vendor (admin, department head)

get.description: One workbook: summary, cost by category, by vendor and (for the whole company) by department, the 20 most expensive subscriptions, paid by month for the last 12 months, a 12-month forecast, the recommendations and the currency rates every rouble amount was converted at.

Expected spending of the active subscriptions, month by month from this one: payments by next_payment_date and billing period up to the end date, plus the monthly cost of subscriptions without a next_payment_date (estimated). run_rate_rub is the cost if everything were renewed. A head gets their own department.

Advice from the rules: unused seats, nobody using a subscription, several subscriptions of one vendor, individual copies of one product, an unlimited licence used by few, monthly billing for over a year, an expired subscription with licences still out. Sorted by yearly saving; advice whose saving cannot be computed comes last with savings_rub_year null.
Paid payments summed by the month of their payment date, in roubles at the current rates; every month of the period is present. Default: the last 12 months; at most 60.

Counts, monthly and annual cost in roubles, seat usage, licences and cost per user. The admin may pick a department and also gets payment figures and the recommendations' count and savings; a head always gets their own department and no payment figures.
Active subscriptions by monthly cost, with seat usage and the monthly cost per licence handed out.
Admin: all. Manager: those of their department's subscriptions plus their own. Employee: their own. Newest first.

post.description: Admin: any active or expiring_soon subscription to any active user. Manager: only their department's subscriptions, only to people of their department. Takes one seat.

get.description: Visible as in the list; anything else is a 404.

post.description: Frees the seat; the row stays as history. Allowed to the admin, the manager of the subscription's department, and the holder (giving it back).

get.description: Who changed what, newest first. actor_id null means the system. Actions are "<entity>.<verb>", e.g. user.update, subscription.delete, assignment.revoke, request.approve.

post.description: Checks email and password and returns a JWT. An unknown email and a wrong password both answer 401 with the same message; a blocked account answers 403.

get.description: Returns the user the bearer token belongs to.

post.description: Replaces the caller's password after checking the current one. Issued tokens stay valid.

get.description: Every currency with its current rate to roubles, RUB first. Open to everyone signed in: forms need the list.

post.description: The code is three Latin letters (stored upper-case), the rate is how many roubles one unit costs: above 0, at most 6 decimals.

delete.description: Only a currency no subscription, request or payment uses (409 otherwise). RUB cannot be deleted (409).

patch.description: Rename and/or set a new rate; at least one field. The new rate applies at once to every report. The rate of RUB is fixed at 1 (409).

get.description: Admin: all departments, sorted by name. Anyone else: only their own department (zero or one item).

post.description: The name is unique case-insensitively. The head, if given, must be an active manager who heads no other department; they are moved into the new department.

get.description: Admin: any department. Anyone else: only their own; another department is a 404.

delete.description: Only an empty department can be deleted: no active users and no subscriptions (409 otherwise, with the counts). Blocked users and past requests that point at it are detached.

patch.description: Rename and/or change the head; at least one field. A new head must be an active manager who heads no other department and is moved into this one; the previous head stays in the department. `"head_id": null` leaves it without a head.

get.description: The caller's own notifications, newest first, with the unread count.
Admin: all. Manager: their department's plus their own (incoming ones: ?status=pending_manager). Employee: their own. Newest first.

post.description: An employee's request goes to the head of their department, or straight to the admin when there is no head; a manager's goes to the admin. name and justification are required; currency defaults to RUB.

get.description: Visible as in the list; anything else is a 404.

post.description: The department head moves a pending_manager request to pending_admin. The admin approves a pending_admin request (or a pending_manager one when the department has no head) and picks the subscription: an existing one (subscription_id) or a new one (subscription), and the requester gets a licence of it - all in one transaction. If the licence cannot be handed out (no free seats, cancelled subscription, the requester already holds it) the answer is 409 and the request stays pending.

parameters.description: Comment and, for the admin, the subscription
parameters.name: body

post.description: Only the requester, only while the request is pending.
The department head rejects at pending_manager, the admin at pending_admin (or at pending_manager when the department has no head). A comment is required.

get.description: How many days before the end date a subscription becomes expiring_soon (its holders and the admins are warned), and how many days before the next payment the admins are reminded.

put.description: Both values are required, each 0..365 days (0 = only on the day itself). The scheduler uses the new values from its next run.

get.description: Admin: all. Manager: their department's plus the ones they hold a licence of. Employee: the ones they hold a licence of. Deleted subscriptions are never listed. Sorted by name.

parameters.description: Substring of the name or vendor
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: true: a seat limit with seats left over (unused seats); false: every seat taken. Enterprise matches neither
parameters.name: free_seats

post.description: Starts active with no licences handed out. individual always has 1 seat; group needs seats_total; enterprise is unlimited (no seats_total). The currency must exist in the currencies table.

get.description: Every subscription matching the same filters as the list, as an .xlsx sheet.

parameters.description: true: seats left over; false: every seat taken
parameters.name: free_seats

get.description: Visible as in the list; anything else is a 404.

delete.description: Soft delete: the row stays for payment history, but is no longer listed. Every licence is revoked.

patch.description: Partial update; at least one field. status may be set to active or cancelled only (expiring_soon and expired are set by the scheduler); cancelling revokes every licence. seats_total cannot go below seats_used (409). Changing type without seats_total resets the seats: 1 for individual, unlimited for enterprise, group then needs seats_total.

get.description: By payment date, newest first (`order=asc`: oldest first). Expected payments: `status=pending&order=asc`.

post.description: A one-off payment or a past one; it is stored as paid. Cancelled and expired subscriptions are accepted too. 409 when the subscription already has a payment on that date.

get.description: Every payment matching the same filters as the list, as an .xlsx sheet, by payment date (newest first; `order=asc`: oldest first).

post.description: Only from pending. A failed payment can still be paid later.
From pending or failed. The body is optional; a given payment_method or invoice_number is stored.

get.description: Admin: all users. Manager: only their department (the department_id filter is ignored). Employee: 403. Sorted by full name.

parameters.description: true: only active, false: only blocked
parameters.name: active

parameters.description: Substring of full name or email
parameters.name: q

post.description: The admin sets the initial password and hands it to the person. The email is unique case-insensitively (409 on a clash).

get.description: Admin: any user. Manager: users of their department. Employee: only themselves. A user outside the caller's view is a 404.

patch.description: Partial update; at least one field. `"is_active": false` blocks the user (their tokens stop working at once), `true` unblocks. `"department_id": null` removes them from their department. If the user headed a department and is blocked, demoted or moved out of it, that department is left without a head. Blocking also revokes all their licences. An admin cannot block themselves or drop their own admin role (409).

put.description: Sets a new password, e.g. when the person forgot theirs. Issued tokens stay valid.

total_rub.description:
TotalRUB sums the months; RunRateRUB is what they would cost if every
active subscription were renewed (monthly cost × months).

text.example: Занято 30 из 50 мест Jira. Сократите 20 мест — сэкономите 120 000 ₽/год.

total_savings_rub_year.description: TotalSavingsRUBYear sums the savings that could be computed.

unread.description: Unread counts all unread notifications, whatever the page.

comment.example: У отдела уже есть Canva, используйте её

seats_total.description: SeatsTotal and SeatsFree are null for enterprise (unlimited).
